products.themeKey: Offline Club Host Kit: printable signs, phone check-in ticke
products.superPrompt:
You are a product designer and event host writing a complete, sellable printable kit called "Offline Club Host Kit" for [YOUR SHOP NAME].

BUYER AND JOB: The buyer is a college student, RA, campus club officer, librarian or 20-something who wants to start or run a phone-free social (an "offline club" night: phones checked at the door, then reading, journaling, puzzles, crafts and conversation). They need everything to run the first four nights without designing anything: signs, a phone check-in system, prompts, activity stations and a simple way to grow attendance.

DELIVERABLE (produce the full text for every page; US Letter 8.5x11 in and A4 versions share the same content):
1. Cover page: kit title, one-line promise ("Everything you need to host a phone-free night"), contents list.
2. Host guide (2 pages): what an offline night is, a 90-minute run-of-show (arrival and phone check-in 10 min, quiet hour 40 min, conversation and games 30 min, close 10 min), venue checklist, supplies list under $30, accessibility and inclusion notes (alternatives for people on call, caregivers, medical needs), and a line saying participation is voluntary.
3. Door sign (poster, 1 page): "Phones asleep, people awake" style headline you write yourself, plus 3 house rules.
4. Phone check-in tickets: 24 numbered tear-off tickets per page (2 matching halves each) and a check-in log sheet with columns: ticket #, first name, emergency contact OK? (Y/N).
5. Station cards (6 half-page cards): Reading Nook, Journal Corner, Puzzle Table, Analog Art, Letter Writing, Board Games, each with 3 short instructions.
6. Conversation prompt cards: 60 original prompts on 6 pages (10 per page, 2.5x3.5 in cards with cut lines), grouped as Light, Curious, Nostalgic, Deep, Funny, Future. No therapy or trauma prompts.
7. Journal prompt strips: 30 original prompts.
8. Event poster template (1 page) with blanks: date, time, place, what to bring; plus a 1080x1920 px story version layout description.
9. Four themed night plans (1 page each): Cozy Reading Night, Puzzle and Pie, Letters to Future You, Analog Art Jam, each with supplies, run-of-show tweaks and 5 themed prompts.
10. Feedback slip (4 per page) and a simple attendance tracker for 8 weeks.

DESIGN: Canva font pairing A: "Fraunces" (headings) + "Inter" (body). Pairing B: "DM Serif Display" + "Work Sans". Palette: Paper #F6F1E7, Ink #2B2A28, Moss #5B6B4E, Clay #C46A4A, Butter #F2D27A. Generous margins (0.5 in), cut lines dashed #B8B2A6.

RULES: All wording must be original. Do not use the name "The Offline Club" or any organization's name, logo or slogan; use generic phrases like "offline night" or "phone-free social". No health, mental-health or productivity claims (do not say it cures anxiety or addiction). No references to brands, apps or celebrities. Reading level: grade 7-9, warm and playful.

DIFFERENTIATION: Existing Etsy conversation-card sets are generic dinner or date-night decks. This kit is a complete host system for a recurring phone-free club: check-in tickets, stations, run-of-show and four ready night plans.

OUTPUT FORMAT: Write page by page with headings "PAGE 1", "PAGE 2", etc. For each page give: layout note, every line of text, and where cut lines go. End with a SELF-CHECK list confirming: (a) 60 conversation prompts and 30 journal prompts are present and none repeat, (b) no organization or brand names appear, (c) no health claims, (d) every page fits US Letter and A4 with 0.5 in margins, (e) inclusion note is present.

assembly: Run the super prompt and paste each PAGE section into a Canva US Letter doc (8.5x11 in).
Apply font pairing A and the hex palette as Canva brand colors.
Build cut lines with dashed lines #B8B2A6 and test-print the ticket and card pages.
Duplicate the design and resize to A4 (Canva Resize), fixing any overflow.
Export both as PDF Print with crop marks off, 300 DPI.
Create a 1-page 'Read me' PDF with download and printing tips.
Make 5 listing images: cover, contents grid, ticket close-up, station cards, night plans.
products.listingPrompt: Write an Etsy listing for a printable 'phone-free social host kit' for college clubs and young adults. Title under 140 characters starting with 'Phone Free Party Printable Kit'. Give 13 tags of 20 characters or fewer (e.g., phone free party, offline night, digital detox party, college club ideas). Description: what is included (page list), US Letter and A4 PDFs, instant download and printing tips, a note that the kit is not affiliated with any organization, and an FAQ (Can I print multiple copies for my club? products.superPrompt:
You are a game writer creating an original printable deck called "Phone-Free Table Talk: 120 Conversation Cards for Offline Nights" for [YOUR SHOP NAME].

BUYER AND JOB: Young adults who host or attend phone-free socials, dinner parties and campus offline nights. They want cards that get strangers talking within minutes without being cringe or too intense.

DELIVERABLE: 120 cards, poker size 2.5x3.5 in, 9 per US Letter page and 9 per A4 page with cut lines (14 pages each), plus a cover card, a how-to-play card and 3 game variations (Pass the Stack, Two Truths and a Prompt, Hot Seat Lite). Six suits of 20 cards: Warm-Up, Tiny Joys, Then and Now, What Would You Do, Hot Takes (harmless), Big Picture. Each card: suit name, a number, one prompt under 20 words. Also supply a single-page "table tent" version listing 12 favorite prompts.

DESIGN: Canva pairing A: "Recoleta" alternative "Fraunces" + "Inter"; pairing B: "Bricolage Grotesque" + "Nunito". Palette: Cream #FAF4E8, Charcoal #2E2D2B, Sage #8FA382, Terracotta #C8673F, Sky #9DB7C9. Each suit gets one accent color.

RULES: 100% original prompts. No brands, apps, celebrities, TV shows or organization names (do not use "The Offline Club"). No prompts about trauma, sex, politics, religion, money shaming or appearance. No claims about mental health. Inclusive: avoid assumptions about family, gender, relationships or ability to travel.

DIFFERENTIATION: Written for groups of strangers at a phone-free event, with a quick game structure, instead of generic couple or family decks.

OUTPUT: List cards by suit as "SUIT – #: prompt". Then the rules card text, the variations and the table tent. Finish with a SELF-CHECK: 120 unique prompts, all under 20 words, no banned topics, no names or brands, suits balanced at 20 each.

PRINT PREP AND QUALITY: For every design also specify: the safe area (keep text at least 0.125 in inside the cut line), the minimum text height for legibility at 3 in (about 0.18 in cap height), whether the design works as a one-color version for vinyl, and a dark-surface variant (swap ink to cream). Limit each design to four palette colors so printing stays crisp. Give each design a short product title (under 60 characters) and a one-sentence description a buyer would understand without context.

AUDIENCE TONE: Warm, in-group humor that a beginner understands; never mock outsiders, beginners or other generations. Avoid slang that will date within months unless it is the joke. Keep all phrases short (under 6 words where possible) so they read from a distance.

MOCKUP AND LISTING SUPPORT: After the designs, propose 3 lifestyle mockup scenes (surface, props, lighting, colors) that show scale, and 5 short hook lines for a TikTok or Reel showing the stickers in use. Do not include real people's faces, brand logos or recognizable products in any scene.
